diagnosis: The checks do not enforce the acceptance requirement for commitments covering the calendar change and casting-footage controls. A settlement can pass every listed check while omitting those two required commitments.
evidence: Acceptance condition 6 requires safety, calendar-change, and footage-control commitments, but only C7 checks a safety commitment; there are no checks for the latter two.
fix_instructions: Add boolean content checks requiring commitments whose details explicitly record the Studio 2 calendar change and the 14-day, named-casting-team-only footage controls.
